from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper from the collection: its title and citation relationships with other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper references")
    cited_by: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
